0.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF4_00197_MOBHUNTERF1F4_000_1
0.description: Chasing an elite mark, I presume. Adventurers hither, adventurers thither. Soon we shall have to write <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> into the Raimdelle Codex.

3.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF4_00197_A1_000_2
3.description: Tell me about the rank B elite mark. (Phecda)

4.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF4_00197_A1_000_3
4.description: Tell me about the rank A elite mark. (Girtab)

5.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF4_00197_A1_000_4
5.description: Tell me about the rank S elite mark. (Thousand-cast Theda)

7.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF4_00197_MOBHUNTERF1F4_000_10
7.description: I am the elite mark hunter. I contemplate the codex, hunt the hideous, and preserve the peace.

8.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF4_00197_MOBHUNTERF1F4_000_11
8.description: And of course, I bag the bounty of Allied Seals when I do slay one of those mischief-makers.

9.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF4_00197_MOBHUNTERF1F4_000_12
9.description: If you have something to ask, don't tarry. The elite mark waits for no one.

10.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF4_00197_MOBHUNTERF1F4_000_13
10.description: In fact, sometimes it will seem that a rank S elite mark appears for no one. “S” would be the most feral of the elite marks. They are ranked by danger, you see.

11.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF4_00197_MOBHUNTERF1F4_000_20
11.description: “A bear of unusual size from the distant heights of Abalathia's Spine, Phecda's southward migration has not been a happy one for the Black Shroud.

12.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF4_00197_MOBHUNTERF1F4_000_21
12.description: “Its uncouth appetite has emptied whole areas of the forest of edibles and game, and no hunter has returned with evidence of a cull─or returned at all. Phecda may be distinguished from its more peaceable cousins by the constant slick of blood upon its claws.”

13.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF4_00197_MOBHUNTERF1F4_000_30
13.description: “Girtab, the mightiest among mites that ravage the North Shroud.

14.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF4_00197_MOBHUNTERF1F4_000_31
14.description: “Painstaking field observations have revealed that the Girtab prefers its prey fresh, and keeps a living larder of two- and four-legged meals artfully held fast in a web.”

15.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF4_00197_MOBHUNTERF1F4_000_40
15.description: “Botanists call Thousand-cast Theda as well grown a specimen of ochu as ever has been recorded in the North Shroud, but the foolishness of botanists is a fact well known and oft deplored.

16.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF4_00197_MOBHUNTERF1F4_000_41
16.description: “Most species of this carnivorous family of bindweed use scent to lure their insect prey. Theda, however, is a plant notably lacking in patience and has evolved tentacle-like vines to pluck fish from water, and grows outsized on its rich meals.

17.name: TEXT_REGFSTNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF4_00197_MOBHUNTERF1F4_000_42
17.description: “Along with the fisherfolk of the Shroud, Thousand-cast Theda is the main predator of venomous stingrays. Theda's other favored prey is, coincidentally, the fisherfolk of the Shroud. Hunters suspect a connection, but the foolishness of hunters is a fact well known.”
